reviewed_primary_surfaces.finding: Forecasts 2024 QLC enterprise SSD bit shipments at 30 EB; this remains the Judgment being evaluated, not realized Outcome.
Reports 1Q24 enterprise SSD revenue and greater-than-20-percent Q2 enterprise SSD bit-procurement growth; no full-year absolute QLC-enterprise-SSD EB or unit total.
Estimates greater-than-45 EB AI-related SSD procurement capacity for 2024; scope is broader/different and is not a revision or realized Outcome for the April QLC-enterprise-SSD series.
Public abstract exposes 3Q24 enterprise SSD revenue growth and shipment direction but no absolute full-year QLC-enterprise-SSD volume.
Reports 3Q24 total enterprise SSD procurement volume up 15% QoQ and industry revenue up 28.6% QoQ; denominator remains absent.
Public 4Q24 enterprise-SSD report abstract describes demand/revenue conditions but does not expose a directly comparable 2024 full-year QLC-enterprise-SSD absolute EB or unit measurement.
Reports 4Q24 major-supplier enterprise SSD revenue at US$7.34B and -0.5% QoQ; revenue cannot evaluate the 30 EB shipment Judgment.
Discusses 2024 leadership in high-capacity products and 1Q25 shipment-bit/ASP changes, but still does not expose a realized full-year 2024 QLC-enterprise-SSD absolute volume.

scope_adjacent_non_matches.claim: Models the total eSSD market at 181 EB in 2024 under a baseline scenario.
scope_adjacent_non_matches.reason: Total enterprise-SSD model scope is not QLC-enterprise-SSD realized bit shipments, and the value is presented as scenario modeling rather than a directly comparable TrendForce realized series.

result.interpretation: The April 2024 30 EB QLC-enterprise-SSD forecast remains a contemporaneous Judgment with no recovered directly comparable realized full-year public measurement. Public later TrendForce material supports strong quarterly enterprise-SSD demand and revenue observations but does not truthfully close the annual absolute-volume Outcome gap.

guardrails: not_found != false: this result records non-recovery on bounded public surfaces, not non-existence of a measured series.
Paid TrendForce datasets may contain unpublished annual absolute-volume fields; public abstract non-recovery cannot negate that possibility.
Do not evaluate the 30 EB Judgment using the greater-than-45 EB AI-related estimate, quarterly procurement growth, revenue, or supplier cumulative QLC shipments.
Do not infer annual absolute EB by chaining quarterly percentage changes without directly observed denominators.

lead_dispositions.researcher_interpretation: The 30 EB 2024 QLC-enterprise-SSD forecast remains replayable as Judgment, but a public directly comparable realized annual Outcome was not recovered after deeper TrendForce and cross-publisher search.
Quarterly methodological-primary observations substantiate enterprise-SSD demand acceleration, but they remain separate from annual absolute shipment volume.
